## Checklist

- [ ] `just validate <id>` passes (or I rely on CI)
- [ ] Images come from the project or a well-known packager, on the tag it recommends (databases on a major tag)
- [ ] Shares are read-only unless the app must write
- [ ] Permissions (`devices`, `capabilities`, `host_network`, `docker_socket`) are needed and explained in `notes`
- [ ] I started the app with Docker and opened its web interface
